manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 200
text:
Page 001
001-1. THE WARRIORESS HAS BEEN HERE FOR ALMOST A YEAR.
001-2. 间 脑空 下水道 2
001-3. AFTER HALF A MONTH, IT WILL BE EXACTLY ONE YEAR, 365 DAYS.
001-4. TIME REALLY FLIES BY SO QUICKLY...
001-5. ORIGINALLY, I THOUGHT IT WOULDTAKEATLEAST A FEWYEARS BEFORESHEWOULD BE ABLE TO INTEGRATE INTO SOCIET, BUT BECAUSEOF THE INTERNET, THE WARRIORESS'S INTEGRATION PROCESS WAS AS FAST AS SITTING ON A PLANE.
001-6. NOT ONLY DID SHE LEARN HOW TO PLAY VIDEO GAMES AND MAKE FRIENDS ONLINE, SHE EVEN LEARNED TO WATCH FILMS... HEH,WOMEN~

Page 002
002-1. THINKING ABOUT IT CAREFULLYFROM A BOY- FRIEND'SPOINTOFVIEW, IT SEEMS THAT I HAVEN'T PROPERLYGIVEN HER AGIFTYET.
002-2. IT'S NOT EVERY DAY YOU COMMEMORATE THE FIRST YEARANNIVERSARY OF TIME TRAVELING, SO I NEEDTOTHINKABOUT IT CAREFULLY.
002-3. AM I HAND- SOME OR NOT? DO ILOOK LIKE QINQIONG?
002-4. T/N: Qin Qiong was a Chinese general who lived in the early Tang dynasty of China.
002-5. DOES THIS STUPID EXPRESSION LOOK LIKE YOUR DEPUTY LEADER?

Page 003
003-1. AMIHANDSOMEORNOT!?IMASKING YOU IF I'M HANDSOMEOR NOT!?
003-2. THE DEPUTY LEADER ISN'T THAT STUPID.
003-3. BY THE WAY, THERE ARE STILL SOME UNUSED IRON RINGS FROM THE CHAINMAIL,
003-4. SHALL I MAKE YOU AN IRON SKIRT?
003-5. WHAT'S THE POINT? TO PREVENT OTHERS FROM CHOPPING AT MY LEGS? AND HOW WOULD I WEAR IT? IT'LL FALL FROM THE WEIGHT.
003-6. I CAN ADD TWO SUSPENDERS TO MAKE IT A SUSPENDER SKIRT, THAT WAY IT WON'T FALL.
003-7. I'M JUST JOKING.
003-8. IWASTEASING YOU~

Page 004
004-1. HMPH, I'M GOING TO STREAM! I'M PUSHING1700 TODAY
004-2. ARE YOU GOING TO...

Page 005
005-1. ...NOTHING.
005-2. I DON'T CARE WHERE THAT GUY SLEEPS! ITS MORECOMFORTABLE BEING ALONE IN A BIGBED!
005-3. HAS THIS GUY REALLY CHANGED HIS MIND? HE WON'T PLAY ANYTRICKS?

Page 006
006-1. I DON'T CARE ANYMORE, TIME TO SLEEP!
006-2. DIDN'T YOU SAY YOU'RE WEREN'T GOING TO MOVE?
006-3. I DIDN'T MOVE, MY PILLOW AND SHEETS ARE STILL OVER THERE.
006-4. I'M HERE TO TALK TO YOU ABOUT SOME- THING.IT'S ABOUT THE IDENTITY ISSUE, IT'S QUITE DIFFICULT TO SOLVE.
006-5. IF IT DOESN'T SUCCEED THE FIRST TRY, IT'LL BE MORE DIFFICULTLATERON, SO YOU MUST BE FULLY PREPARED FOR THE FIRST TRY, UNDERSTAND?

Page 007
007-1. I KNOW THAT.
007-2. I'M JUST WORRIED THAT YOU'RE IMPATIENT. BUT THERE'S ISN'T MUCH A NEED FOR AN ID RIGHT NOW, SO WE JUST NEED TO PREPARE WITH A PEACE OF MIND. YOU'RE QUITE FAMILIAR WITH THIS COMMUNITY NOW..
007-3. BY THE END OF THE YEAR, YOU WILL HAVE SPENT'TWOSPRING FESTIVALS HERE, AND THE NEIGHBORS AROUND US WILL HAVE A GENERAL IMPRESSION OF YOU.
007-4. AUNTIE CHENG AND LITTLE YAN ARE STRONG WITNESSES. THEY KNOW THAT I HAVE BEEN PURSUING YOU FOR SEVERAL YEARS,AND HOW YOU MOVED IN FROM THE OUTSIDE.
007-5. THERE'S ALSO THE SKY'S EYE (CCTV) OUTSIDE, I DON'T KNOWIF THAT WILL BE AN ISSUE.
007-6. ANYWAY.THE FACT THAT YOU APPEARED OUT OF THIN AIR HAS BEEN WIPED OUT NOW AND THERE'S NO NEED TO WORRY ABOUT THE POLICE INVESTIGATING.
007-7. IT'SA BIG STEP FORWARD...

Page 008
008-1. .WHY DID YOU END UP SLEEP- ING HERE?
008-2. I'MSLEEPY, GOOD NIGHT.
008-3. HMPH.

Page 009
009-1. Good night.
009-2. O Good night.

Page 010
010-1. ARE YOU A DOG?
010-2. .I'MTHE YEAR OF THE DOG!
010-3. HE LIKES TO SMELL EVERY- THING... THING..
010-4. DENG TUZI!
